name: mac_workbench_transaction
why: Overnight cross-node jobs need idempotent, atomic staging of multiple files and a receipt; mac_run_actions is action-oriented and cannot guarantee rollback or deduplicate retries.
status: Resolves to GET /workbench/jobs/:jobId/handoff (confidence 0.737, high). That is a read, so calling this tool really calls it.
note: If this tool takes an enum, each value resolves separately — one branch can be live while another is not.
